description: Structured Pydantic schema for ProblemStatementAnalyzer output.

problem_statement.description: Clear, concise formulation of the core problem being analyzed.
problem_statement.title: Problem Statement

affected_users.description: User groups or personas impacted by this problem.
affected_users.title: Affected Users

root_causes.description: Underlying root causes giving rise to the problem.
root_causes.title: Root Causes

existing_solutions.description: Current manual workarounds or existing solutions employed today.
existing_solutions.title: Existing Solutions

solution_gaps.description: Deficiencies, gaps, or limitations in current solutions.
solution_gaps.title: Solution Gaps

problem_severity.description: Severity level of the pain point ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical').
problem_severity.title: Problem Severity

urgency_score.description: Market urgency score rating from 0 (nice-to-have) to 100 (critical hair-on-fire).
urgency_score.title: Urgency Score

confidence_score.description: Analysis confidence rating score between 0.00 and 1.00.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

title: ProblemStatementAnalysis
